Utterly disappointed & feel sad for such a lovely ambience
May 2025 • Solo
Disappointed with my Saturday lunch! Place have a lovely vibe, the beach view, the HonTre island view is just amazing! U can see people swimming, surfing and relaxing on the beach! Had a nice chicken Caesar salad and a lovely seafood spaghetti! But the service was a major major let down! Disaster I must say! Initially I ordered a Mai Tai and it took close to 20-25 mins to be served that too after reminding, I thought I was a one off instance! However cannot be justified as there was only 1 table occupied other than mine! Lasted ordered a mojito and again it took 20 mins and I just had to cancel my order and leave! Ample staff but too occupied within themselves all gathered to the corner where there are no guests at all! Won’t go back! It’s really disheartening that such a beautiful place and I won’t be able to revisit as I am utterly disappointed! 
Food menu is good and chefs seem to know your job well with the taste and also the food presentation!

Beautiful Beach Bar - Nha Trang Beach Restaurant in Secluded and Quiet Area
Jan 2025 • Couples
We stayed at Ana Beach during our visit to Nha Trang , this Beach Club remains in a central area, a bit secluded from the chaos of the city so ideal for spending a day at the beach, maybe having lunch or dinner or just drinking tea, coffee 'or a Cocktails as we did , the infinity pool is beautiful, and the stretch of beach in front is well maintained with white sand sun loungers and umbrellas immersed in the tall palm trees the climate in January was a bit 'dancer and rough sea, however ideal in the months from March onwards . We spent a few hours in peace after a city tour the location is nice, simple, modern decor with some Vietnamese detail, the staff is courteous and the wi - fi well working.
